headline: Price Up 10 Times in Half a Year! Completely Out of Control
summary: The Baltic Exchange's TD3C VLCC route rate reached US$1.2125 million a day, up 40.64% week on week and far above about US$117,400 in February. The rise follows the US-Iran conflict.
why: Very large crude carriers move much of the world's seaborne oil, so their charter rates reflect tanker supply and oil trade flows that feed into energy costs.
why_moved: The input reports the TD3C route rate jumped 40.64% week on week and has risen sharply since the US-Iran conflict began.
